final: WITH by_funding AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'NULL') as funding_source, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) as distinct_projects, AVG(CAST(sp.boxy AS FLOAT) / CAST(sp.boxz AS FLOAT)) as ratio_avg FROM scanspatial sp JOIN projects p ON sp.arcref = p.arcregistry WHERE sp.boxy IS NOT NULL AND sp.boxz IS NOT NULL AND sp.boxz != 0 GROUP BY COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'NULL')), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(distinct_projects AS FLOAT)) as avg_pc FROM by_funding), kept_funding AS (SELECT bf.distinct_projects, bf.ratio_avg, ac.avg_pc FROM by_funding bf CROSS JOIN avg_count ac WHERE bf.distinct_projects > ac.avg_pc) SELECT AVG(ratio_avg) as avg_ratio, SUM(distinct_projects) as total_projects, AVG(CAST(distinct_projects AS FLOAT) - avg_pc) as avg_excess FROM kept_funding
